messages:
Aisha: Quick heads-up — we just crossed 75M tokens served this month! :tada: Thank you team, wild.
Ben: OMG yes!! Ice cream truck? :ice_cream: wheels up at 2pm?
Kavya: Love it. Can we do a tiny karaoke set on the roof too? low-effort, high-energy 🎤
Liam: I have a portable speaker and a very questionable playlist. I’m in.
Maya: Vote: ice cream + karaoke or stickers + pizza? React with :one: for ice cream+karaoke, :two: for stickers+pizza
ops-bot: Deploy bot reminder: staging -> prod promotion scheduled at 18:00; milestone friendly ✅
Aisha: @Maya good call. Let’s do ice cream + karaoke if we get more :one: reactions by 11:30. Also cake for folks who prefer dessert solidarity.
Ben: I’ll handle ordering the truck — any dietary notes? vegan option yes pls.
Kavya: Can we add a tiny sign-up for song requests? so we don’t get 10x Bohemian Rhapsody in a row 😂
Liam: Here’s a dumb google form link for sign-ups: https://tiny.example/75m-songs (placeholder)
Maya: Putting an office table near the elevator so people can pick stickers + milestone pins for folks remote
Aisha: Big shoutout to infra team for the weekend burn — real hero moves. :raised_hands:
Ben: Seriously, shoutout to @devon and @ops for the rollout script that saved us 3 hours.
Kavya: Can someone grab a mic stand? otherwise Liam will hold the phone like 2012.
Liam: I accept the patriarchy of phone-mic holding. Also bringing neon socks for the brave performers.
Aisha: Perfect. See you all at 2pm (roof) — bring your best karaoke energy, and thank you again ❤️
